## Setup

### Python and Virtual Environment Installation

``` sh
* curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh uv python install 3.13
```

### Install programming_first_principles in Development mode

``` sh
$ uv pip install -e .
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/gophry/programming-first-principles):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/gophry/programming-first-principles.git
```

### Commiting Changes

- nbdev-export
  - Exports source code to modules from notebooks
- nbdev-test
  - extracts and executes code cells across your Jupyter notebooks to
    ensure that your library, documentation, and unit tests function
    without error
- nbdev-preview
  - Preview how the website documentation looks like.
- nbdev-clean
- git commit and git push origin main

def prepare_notebook():
    ip = get_ipython()
    if ip is None: return
    from IPython.core.interactiveshell import InteractiveShell
    InteractiveShell.ast_node_interactivity = "all"
    from array import array
    from pprint import pprint
    from wigglystuff import LiveEdit
    import operator
    from functools import partial 
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    from collections import namedtuple
    import random, copy 
    import ctypes
    import sys
    from ipaddress import IPv4Address
    from typing import Sequence
    import numpy as np
    import inspect
    ip.user_ns.update(
        array=array, 
        pprint=pprint, 
        LiveEdit=LiveEdit, 
        operator=operator, 
        partial=partial, 
        plt=plt,
        namedtuple=namedtuple,
        random=random,
        copy=copy,
        ctypes=ctypes,
        sys=sys,
        IPv4Address=IPv4Address,
        Sequence=Sequence,
        np=np,
        inspect=inspect
    )
